selection_rules.selection_strategy: Choose drinking-water or fountain results at route anchors and keep them as evenly distributed as the available search results allow.
important_limitations: The business search data did not expose Google Maps photo URLs.
The business search data did not expose exact latitude/longitude for every place.
For several stops, coordinates are approximate town/route-anchor coordinates and must be verified manually or with Google Places API before final submission.
Because the middle part of the GPX route has sparse fountain listings in search results, two stops are near Vipiteno and two are near Borso del Grappa.
